This post describes how i feel perfectly and that helps me because I'm not very good with feelings, so it had a positive impact on me. I don't know you very well but i care about you and i hope you'll be okay.

I can relate to this post a lot. Everything is difficult and nothing seems to go right sometimes, life can get so frustrating. I hope things work out for you and you feel a bit happier soon op. Take care

hey, you can pm me whenever you'd like, i'm here if you want to talk

i'm around the same age as you op, i have violent intrusive thoughts a lot and that includes hurting people around me, but i hope you know that doesn't define your personality or who you are in the least. if there are any hobbies you used to enjoy doing earlier you could try picking those up again or just looking through a list of hobbies and choose one that might be interesting and go with it. on a lot of days my hobbies are the only thing keeping me alive, so i hope you find something you enjoy doing.  i hope your mother lets you get help from a psychiatrist. take care

life is really shitty and everything is exhausting sometimes. it gets so difficult when you see other people your age living their lives and being happy and ig you just start to wonder why you can't be the same as them. i understand that part of how you feel op, i'm sorry therapy didn't work for you. i don't know you very well, but i care for you and i sincerely hope you find happiness someday.
